labels.label: Modular Grover — Oracle → amplification → measurement. Target 10 has probability 1.
Variational eigensolver — Hamiltonian → reusable trial state → optimization. Ground energy −√1.25 ≈ −1.118034.
QAOA for a two-node cut — Minimize −½ + ½ Z0 Z1, sample the trained circuit, then score it. The two cut states 01 and 10 have energy −1.
